findings.recommendation: Keep the documentation; consider a signed/opaque session hint so the edge gate cannot be forged, or remove the exp pre-check entirely.

findings.title: Worker `.env.example` omits `APP_BASE_URL`
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: documented at apps/worker/.env.example:41 (PR #125, c2bdb59a).
findings.recommendation: None required; the proposed env-parity check keeps it that way.

findings.title: Web runtime validator can silently fall back to a localhost API URL
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: the production throw exists (env.ts:87-92) but the Dockerfile ENV default pre-populates the variable, so the guard cannot fire in the image build; downgraded from verified-fixed to partially-fixed.
findings.recommendation: Remove the localhost ENV defaults from the Dockerfile builder stage (keep an explicit dev-only default out of the production image), or make the guard assert the value is not the localhost fallback when NODE_ENV=production; add a CI build test that omits the arg and expects failure.

findings.title: No IT-level break-glass / emergency credential revocation runbook, and no revocation drill evidence
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: no runbook at the referenced path, escrow undefined, no drill evidence. Related new finding: the broken reference itself (see 'Incident response points at a secret-rotation runbook that is not in docs/').
findings.recommendation: Publish docs/SECRET_ROTATION_RUNBOOK.md (or fold it into SECRETS_ROTATION.md) covering break-glass authorization, escrow location, and revocation steps; link it from docs/INDEX.md and INCIDENT_RESPONSE.md; run and record one revocation drill.

findings.title: Secret rotation policy has no evidence any secret was ever rotated
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d (was open, not re-verified in the previous run): Rotation Log still single-row; no rotation artifact.
findings.recommendation: Record every rotation (including drills) in the log with date, operator, environment and run URL; add a mechanical check that no key exceeds its cadence based on the log.

findings.title: No automated `.env.example` ↔ runtime schema ↔ docs parity check
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d; extends the previous runbook's proposed 'CI schema↔example↔docs parity check' to workflow secrets as well.
findings.recommendation: Add a dependency-free script to validate.yml that extracts keys from the three Zod schemas, the three .env.example files, and the docs tables, and fails on any mismatch; include workflow secrets.X against SECRETS_ROTATION.md.

findings.title: Visual regression is still non-blocking with a known-broken Storybook build
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: chromatic.yml still continue-on-error with the SB_BUILDER-WEBPACK5_0002 comment and exitZeroOnChanges; no Playwright screenshot baselines added.
findings.recommendation: Fix the Storybook/Next build or replace Chromatic with Playwright `toHaveScreenshot()` baselines for the top pages already running in E2E.

findings.title: No scheduled production smoke check (health + login + critical read)
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: deploy-time health gate only; no scheduled prod smoke workflow exists.
findings.recommendation: Add a cron workflow (e.g. every 15 min) that checks prod /health for api+worker, /login for web, and a read-only authenticated request, alerting on failure.

findings.title: Coverage thresholds remain modest and cannot be confirmed met at this SHA
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: API/web thresholds were ratcheted in 0a2e5331 (2026-10-03, ancestor of HEAD); worker unchanged; suites were not executed in this audit and no coverage artifact exists, so 'met' remains unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Publish the coverage summary as a CI artifact (or job summary) from the unit-tests composite; raise the worker gate after TEST-P2-002's suite lands.

findings.title: Coverage thresholds are low and E2E stability is unproven on `main`
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: thresholds ratcheted for api/web (0a2e5331), worker still 5/15/12/12; E2E stability on main remains unproven (prod deploy path still cannot run per AGENTS.md:100).
findings.recommendation: Record one successful prod-gate E2E run (or a staging equivalent) and add flake instrumentation; keep raising the worker gate.

findings.title: Shared packages/ui has no test runner and no lint/typecheck script
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Add a minimal jest config + test script to packages/ui (render tests for Button/Dialog/Badge/Input/Avatar) and lint/typecheck scripts so turbo gates it; or explicitly document that web suites are the only gate.

findings.title: Portal ticket creation gives no success confirmation and the tested action is dead code with a mismatched field name
findings.note: Fresh finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Show a success toast with a link to the new ticket, delete the dead action (or align names), test the live action, and deep-link the dashboard CTA to an open create form.

findings.title: Offline/poor-network support is absent from the running app (service worker never registered)
findings.note: Fresh finding at 8d299b8d. May overlap domain 17 (mobile/PWA); not yet reported there.
findings.recommendation: Register the service worker behind an env flag with a versioned cache, and add an online/offline banner plus a manual retry; or remove sw.js if offline is out of scope.

findings.title: Document version history is display-only: no per-version download/restore and it hides itself for single-version documents
findings.note: Fresh finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Add a per-version download (SDK method + UI action) and an inline error state; show the version section even for one version.

findings.title: Web edit flows never send If-Match, so concurrent admin edits silently overwrite each other
findings.note: Fresh finding at 8d299b8d. Impact is plausible but not reproduced (no live app run).
findings.recommendation: Thread the row version into edit forms and send If-Match; render the API's 409 as 'modified by someone else — reload'.

findings.title: Form error handling is lossy or missing: signup can hang, onboarding errors are generic, bulk invite says 'Request failed'
findings.note: Fresh finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Wrap all submit handlers in try/finally, keep the API's message where it is user-safe, and map validation errors to the offending field.

findings.title: Four Chip copies render a glyph-only '×' remove button with a sub-24px target size
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Single Chip component in the design system with aria-label={`Remove ${label}`} and a min-h-6 min-w-6 (24px) hit area; delete the three copies.

findings.title: Theme is documented dark-only but ships dead light/system code paths (CSS variables, ThemeProvider, Storybook toolbar)
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; the previous run had no UX rows on theming.
findings.recommendation: Either delete the light/system branches, the light CSS block and the Storybook toolbar, or implement a real toggle (and fix cyber-page-bg to use the variable). Whichever is chosen, keep docs/WEB_UI_CONVENTIONS.md:83 in sync.

findings.title: Sidebar group toggles declare aria-haspopup='true' for a popup that is a link list, not a menu
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Remove aria-haspopup (keep aria-expanded + aria-controls), or promote the flyout to a real menu pattern with roving tabindex. Apply to both admin and portal sidebars.

findings.title: Notification bell and store drawer toggles omit aria-expanded
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-expanded to both toggles (and Escape-to-close plus focus return for the bell panel), matching the SidebarShell pattern.

findings.title: Color-token drift: 66 files hardcode hex colors (80x #0A1118) and 45 arbitrary rgba card backgrounds instead of the design tokens
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d. Note the palette itself passes contrast checks (see body) — this is a consistency finding, not a contrast finding.
findings.recommendation: Replace hardcoded values with the existing utilities (text-cyber-base, glass-card, bg-cyber-card-*) in touched files, and add a lint/regex guard that rejects new hex colors in apps/web/app and apps/web/components outside the token files.

findings.title: Heading order skips a level on the store import/export page
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d. A repo-wide heading scan found this as the only h1->h3 skip; all other sampled pages are consistent.
findings.recommendation: Promote the section headings to <h2> (or add an <h2> group heading).

findings.title: ScorecardsEvaluateClient renders the only programmatically unlabeled input in the app and an unannounced error
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d. The same scan found zero icon-only buttons without accessible names, so this is an isolated gap.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-label="Organization ID (optional)" or a visible <label>, and role="alert" on the error span.

findings.title: Signup form inputs lack autocomplete attributes
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d.
findings.recommendation: Add autoComplete="name", "email" and "new-password" to the signup fields.

findings.title: Storybook covers only the 7 @mct/ui primitives; packages/ui has no test/lint scripts and the a11y addon runs nowhere
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; distinct from TEST-P3-001 (which covers the non-blocking visual-regression job itself) because it is about component coverage and the untested library.
findings.recommendation: Add stories for the app primitives, wire @storybook/test-runner or jest-axe assertions for the existing 7 components, add test/lint/typecheck scripts to packages/ui, and make Chromatic blocking once the webpack build failure is fixed.

findings.title: Full accessibility breadth scan (68 routes) is triage-only and not a required check
findings.note: RE-VERIFIED at 8d299b8d (previous run mainecybertech-20261004-full-main-9c0b88c, status open, verified at 9c0b88c): the workflow is still schedule/manual, the default gate still scans 25 routes, and no branch-protection context references it — still triage-only. New residual: docs/CI.md:117 claims continue-on-error: true that .github/workflows/a11y-breadth.yml:17-22 does not set.
findings.recommendation: Ratchet the breadth set into BASE_PAGES in batches (start with the routes that are currently clean), record a violation baseline, and fix docs/CI.md:117 or add continue-on-error deliberately. Prefer failing the weekly run visibly over silently passing.

findings.title: The a11y gate scans only initial page loads; interactive states (dialogs, drawers, filters, bulk bars) and client-fetched content are untested
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; static review of the spec only — the 5s bounded wait usually gives client fetches time to complete, so the main gap is unexercised interactive states rather than empty-state scanning.
findings.recommendation: Add a small interaction suite (open each dialog/drawer, apply a filter chip, bulk-select a row, run axe in the open state) and/or jest-axe unit tests for the shared primitives; keep the bounded-wait fallback but log when it triggers.

findings.title: Test endpoint generates a random idempotency key and never dedups
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: webhook-management.ts:485 still generates a random per-click key with no dedup claim.
findings.recommendation: Route the test ping through the shared dispatcher (or a deterministic test key) so the test exercises the real signing/idempotency/retry path; label test rows in the UI.

findings.title: No committed event catalog or webhook documentation for consumers
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: module docs exist (docs/modules/webhooks.md, webhook-management.md, committed f9a6dc5e) but there is still no event catalog and the M365 signature statements are inaccurate — residual documented.
findings.recommendation: Publish docs/WEBHOOKS.md (event catalog, {event,timestamp,data} envelope, X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hmac>, Idempotency-Key, 5x exponential retry, DLQ semantics) and fix docs/modules/webhooks.md:16,39 to state M365 is clientState-authenticated and unsigned; add a doc-lint that every dispatchWebhook('...') literal appears in the catalog.

findings.title: Worker queued webhook dispatcher inserts deliveries without an idempotency key
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: worker dispatcher always computes/carries an idempotency key and persists it (WH-P1-001 remediation; test covers it).
findings.recommendation: No action.

findings.title: Webhook raw body typed as `string` but consumed as `Buffer`
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: app.ts:117 still stores a string and webhooks.ts:153 still casts it to Buffer.
findings.recommendation: Store the raw bytes: req.rawBody = buf (Buffer), declare rawBody?: Buffer on the request type, and drop the `as Buffer` cast at webhooks.ts:153.

findings.title: Retried deliveries replay a body without the envelope `timestamp` (payload drift)
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d: request_body omits the envelope timestamp and retry replays the stored object as-is.
findings.recommendation: Persist the full original body (including timestamp) in request_body and replay it verbatim, or document that retries carry {event,data} only; add a test asserting the retry body equals the first-attempt body.

findings.title: Delivery inserts ignore unique-key conflicts, losing the successful-attempt record
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d: code-traced conflict path; not reproduced against a live DB (mock returns no error).
findings.recommendation: Check the insert result and update/upsert the existing row on conflict (or log the conflict); add a test that a re-dispatch after failure records the successful attempt.

findings.title: Outbound webhook response bodies are read without a size cap
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d: no max-size guard in either pinned-fetch copy or at the call sites.
findings.recommendation: Cap the response read (e.g. 64kb) in pinnedFetch and truncate/omit response_body beyond the cap; add a test with an oversized response.

findings.title: M365 handler processes only the first notification in a batch (value[0])
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d: code-evident value[0] handling; provider batching behavior not reproduced from the repo.
findings.recommendation: Iterate all notifications (per-notification dedup key and audit/delivery record), or explicitly document and log that only value[0] is processed; add a multi-notification batch test.

findings.title: No retention/cleanup for webhook_deliveries and webhook_dead_letters
findings.note: new finding at 8d299b8d: retention task covers audit_logs/notifications only.
findings.recommendation: Add webhook_deliveries/webhook_dead_letters to the retention task with documented windows (e.g. 90d deliveries, 180d DLQ) and bounded batch deletes; alert on DLQ depth first.
